summary: Early-1930s Aermotor fire tower in Henrico County, Virginia; NHLR-registered 2021; last listed standing, condition after 2021 unconfirmed; county marker 2024.

facts.design: Aermotor tower, 100 ft (30.5 m), modular galvanized steel kit with a 7 by 7 ft cab
facts.status_note: Listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association and registered in 2021, but a 2015 auction notice called it scrap; no source we read confirms its condition after 2021

events.note: County says built in the early 1930s, one of two Henrico towers; 1930 is a placeholder year, no exact year in our sources
U.S. Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: about 110 ft, four-legged steel, glass-enclosed cab, owned and operated by the Virginia Department of Conservation
County says the tower served as a fire lookout until the 1990s; 1990 is a placeholder for that decade, not a documented date
August 2015: placed up for bids in a government auction, listed in scrap condition
Historical marker erected by the County of Henrico on Elko Road, south of US 60

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county and the Forest Lookouts page give 100 ft (kept as 30.5 m, the county's own figure); the Register entry and the 1941 station description give about 110 ft. Both are reported in the story.

The county's coordinates and the Register's point agree to within a few hundred metres, so the Register point is kept. The alternative point in the brief (37.5065, -77.2691) is about 2.7 km further west and is not supported by the county or Register pages.

The 2015 auction notice calls the tower scrap, but the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as standing and the Register registered it in 2021. The county marker is written in the present tense about the site. Standing is kept as the last recorded status, with the condition after 2021 unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Built year is only 'early 1930s' in the county text; the 1930 event year is a placeholder. The 1990 staffed_last year is also a placeholder for 'until the 1990s'. No notable fires are named in any source read. Access level is omitted because no source we read supports one (the brief says unknown). Post-2021 condition is unverified: a Henrico Citizen article on the January 2024 marker was found in search but could not be read (newsbreak fetch refused; the henricocitizen tag page gave only a teaser), so it is worth checking. A Henrico County Facebook post (search snippet only, not read) says the tower has stood since 1933 and could be used if read. The brief's 37.5065, -77.2691 coordinate was not read on the Forest Lookouts page and is only referred to from the brief. Designer spelling differs: county uses Aeromotor, Forest Lookouts and the brief use Aermotor.
